full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a cardiac specimen with a prominent lesion on the heart valve. The image displays a large, smooth, yellowish, bulbous mass or vegetation attached to the valve leaflet. This appearance is characteristic of a cardiac tumor, such as a myxoma, or a large thrombus associated with infective endocarditis.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a segment of a blood vessel, likely an aorta, placed against a blue background. The specimen exhibits a prominent raised atherosclerotic plaque on the intimal surface, characterized by yellowish, lipid-rich deposits and thickening of the vascular wall. These findings are typical of advanced atherosclerosis with atheromatous plaque formation.
